correctness.rationale: The incidence graph is simple with minimum degree at least two, each component uses at least four off-spine vertices and lies in one plane through the common spine, and the four-point page construction attains the bound.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of knowledge; the primary source gives only asymptotically matching complete-bipartite bounds while targeted exact searches found no prior formula.

value.rationale: The result upgrades an explicitly noted complete-bipartite asymptotic case to an exact all-n formula with a structural proof.
